answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it can earn, with the stake slashed if two identities share one operator's keys or hardware fingerprint. Reputation then accrues only through verified completed work, rising slowly like a tide, while a fresh identity starts as a blank ivory slate with zero trust — no velvet shortcut lets a newcomer skip the queue. Cloning identities costs a new stake each time, so flooding the economy becomes more expensive than the rewards it can steal.
